qualificationBasis.decision: The maintainer requested macOS arm64 qualification alongside Windows acceptance, without testing, trial or experimental labels. This row uses its own existing macOS arm64 evidence, not Windows results.

recordedFlows: warm and cold exact Session continuation

acceptance.machineAndExecutionBoundary: Installation, native configuration, model, permission, capability and Session checks remain mandatory.

limitations: This promotion did not rerun a macOS host; the source records separate v3-v6 revisions and the exact tests repeated for each. It does not claim every historical flow ran on the v7 prelude.
Start Plan runtime verification, account refresh, Team Plan dynamic credentials and GUI callbacks remain unimplemented; successful account generation is not claimed.

Full compaction/permission/MCP/usage retry combinations and newer-kernel upgrade qualification remain incomplete. Platform qualification does not declare the entire integration checklist First-Class complete.
Windows x64 and macOS x64 never inherit this result.
